snippet.title: Forensics: Crime Scene Detective | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
🕵️‍♀️ In Forensics: Crime Scene Detective schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Forensik-Spezialist:innen, die die Wahrheit hinter komplexen Kriminalfällen aufdecken müssen.

🔬 Analysiere Spuren im Labor, sichere Beweise am Tatort und triff Entscheidungen, die die Wahrheit ans Licht bringen.

Entwickelt in Zusammenarbeit mit dem LKA Rheinland-Pfalz.
🎮 Bald auf: 
🔹PS5 ➡ https://links.aerosoft.com/ForensicsPS5
🔹Xbox Series X|S ➡ Coming soon!
🔹PC ➡ https://links.aerosoft.com/Forensics

---

🕵️‍♀️ In Forensics: Crime Scene Detective, you step into the role of forensic specialists uncovering the truth behind complex criminal cases.

🔬 Examine evidence in the lab, secure clues at the crime scene, and make decisions that bring the truth to light.

Developed in collaboration with the LKA Rhineland-Palatinate.

🎮 Coming soon to:
🔹 PS5 ➡ https://links.aerosoft.com/ForensicsPS5
🔹 Xbox Series X|S ➡ Coming soon!
🔹 PC ➡ https://links.aerosoft.com/Forensics
